tools.name: vault_status
tools.description: Obento's live state: whether deposits and withdrawals are open, the yearly rate after the fee, the obUSD share price, deposits, ready cash for instant withdrawals, and where the money is.

tools.name: position
tools.description: What an address put into Obento, took out, holds now and earned, Autopilot's fee in dollars, and its latest deposits and withdrawals with their status.

tools.name: autopilot_journal
tools.description: Every move Autopilot made in the last 30 days: money lent to or taken from each place, queued withdrawals it paid, and any pause, newest first.

tools.name: prepare_deposit
tools.description: Deposits are closed while Obento is paused, so this returns an error. Builds the two calls that deposit USDC into Obento for an address: approve the gateway, then deposit with a 0.5% minimum out and partner ID 2. The address signs and sends them in order on Base. Sends nothing itself.

tools.name: prepare_withdrawal
tools.description: Withdrawals are closed while Obento is paused, so this returns an error. Builds the two calls that withdraw from Obento: approve the gateway to take the obUSD, then redeem with a 0.5% minimum out and partner ID 2. Leave out the amount to withdraw everything. Says whether the USDC arrives at once or

tools.name: read_docs
tools.description: One page of Obento's docs as Markdown: how it works, fees, risks, security, contracts, withdrawals, the agent guide and more.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "vault_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
